The Master in Management (MM) program is ideally suited for individuals with diverse perspectives and undergraduate studies in disciplines beyond business. This 12-16 month program is specifically designed for recent graduates and aims to enhance students' understanding of how to excel in an interdisciplinary environment.

Outcomes

Students in this program will:

  • Develop leadership, analytical thinking, and complex problem-solving skills.
  • Learn the importance of collaboration among diverse teams across various cultures and disciplines.
  • Build, facilitate, and engage teams effectively.
  • Identify the social, cultural, and environmental impacts when addressing issues.
  • Gain practical experience through a mandatory co-op work term.

The Master of Engineering (MEng) in Building Envelopes and Structures (BEST) program offers students the opportunity to specialize in the forefront of building envelope design and structural engineering. This program is meticulously designed to address critical challenges within the construction industry, particularly those associated with climate change adaptation and mitigation.

The MEng-BEST program integrates cutting-edge research with practical industry applications, equipping graduates with the knowledge and expertise necessary to excel in the dynamic fields of sustainable construction and advanced engineering solutions.

Research and Experiential Learning:

  • Engaged learning through a mandatory research project.
  • Optional co-op placements provide additional experiential learning opportunities.
  • The newly constructed engineering expansion buildings will serve as venues for case studies and experiments.
8y9g:
The Master of Engineering in Aerospace Systems Engineering equips professionals and graduates with essential skills for the aerospace field, emphasizing Autonomous Aerial Vehicles (AAV). The program integrates conventional aerospace engineering with advances in hybrid-electric propulsion, composite materials, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and autonomous flight operations.

Outcomes

You will be able to:

  • design advanced aerospace systems by integrating mechanical engineering principles, hybrid-electric propulsion, and composite materials
  • apply machine learning and AI to enhance autonomous flight operations and aerospace performance
  • lead interdisciplinary engineering teams through capstone projects on innovative aerial vehicles
  • collaborate effectively in academic and industry research, including partnerships with organizations like CfAR and student-led aerospace teams
  • incorporate sustainable practices and ethical considerations in aerospace technology design and deployment

The MEng in Applied Data Science (MADS) program will prepare students for a high-demand career in data-driven industries. This is an intensive, course-based degree designed for motivated students and IT professionals. Students will learn specialized knowledge in data sciences that are transforming businesses worldwide.

Outcomes

Students in this program will:

  • analyze and manage data sets efficiently and effectively
  • apply data analytic methods in solving problems
  • manage security and privacy in problem solving and decision making
  • understand the role, ethics and responsibilities of an applied data scientist
  • effectively communicate technical knowledge of data science methods and projects and best practices to stakeholders and the broader community

Graduate students registered in full-time programs are automatically considered for a fellowship. This is based on a qualifying GPA.
69js:
The Master of Engineering in Biomedical Systems (BISY) is a 12-month professional graduate program that prepares engineers to design and develop biomedical devices, biomanufacturing processes, biosensors, and regenerative therapies. The program combines a strong compulsory core in medical device design, human physiology, imaging, and human factors with one of three industry-aligned specialization streams, and professional development training.

Students joining the program will select one of the following streams in terms of specialization:

  • Stream 1: Biomanufacturing and Translational Biotechnology (MENG-BISY-TECH)
  • Stream 2: Biomechanics and Biosensing (MENG-BISY-MESE)
  • Stream 3: Biomaterials and Regenerative Medicine (MENG-BISY-BIOR)

Graduates leave BISY with technical depth in a focused area, demonstrable professional skills, and a capstone project completed in partnership with a faculty member or industry sponsor.

The academic component of the program is designed to be completed in 12 months. Students who require additional time may extend their studies; in such cases, re-registration fees will apply for each additional term, up to the program's maximum completion limit.

Following completion of the academic requirements, BISY students may participate in up to three terms of co-op, subject to approval and availability.
69jy:
Master of Engineering in Industrial Ecology

The Master of Engineering in Industrial Ecology (INEC) is a one-year program aimed at students seeking sustainable solutions to global environmental challenges. This applied science program focuses on addressing issues such as climate change and resource inefficiency by optimizing energy and material use across industries, cities, and economies.

Key Learning Outcomes:

  • Develop sustainable technologies to reduce environmental impacts.
  • Apply industrial ecology principles, including industrial metabolism and systems modeling, to optimize resource use.
  • Analyze the economic, political, and regulatory factors shaping sustainable development.
  • Conduct research through a mandatory MEng project, applying methods for ecological restoration and climate strategy.

Curriculum: The program includes six core courses covering topics like industrial metabolism, sustainable cities, and green chemistry, plus a project. Students can choose two electives from areas such as energy decarbonization, environmental modeling, and green building design.

The INEC program prepares students to lead in sustainability, equipping them with the expertise to drive environmental change across various sectors.

There are many businesses out there with the goal of changing the world for the better, but who will lead them? Now is the time to embrace a brave and bold new way of doing things.

The MBA in sustainable innovation is designed to turn great minds into great innovators. Students are here to challenge traditional modes of thinking, to help students navigate the complex challenges that people now face from economic, social and environmental perspectives.

This program is offered as a: Daytime MBA program – for young professionals pursuing their MBA full-time.

Outcomes

  • Business understanding: graduates will have a fundamental understanding of the core business disciplines.
  • Global mindset: graduates will have a global perspective and the international business knowledge to succeed in a complex world.
  • Sustainability/social responsibility: graduates will recognize that organizations and their members have a responsibility to the broader society of which they are a part, and act accordingly.
  • Professionalism: graduates will conduct themselves professionally, communicating effectively, collaborating productively and maintaining high ethical standards.
  • Integration: graduates will effectively integrate knowledge when making complex organizational decisions
  • Creativity: graduates will foster and embrace creativity and innovation.

Note: This program is offered as a: Daytime MBA program – for young professionals pursuing their MBA full-time.” Weekend classes will be one weekend per month.
